answer_1.quote: We generate a single neural caption for each IMAGECODE target image by passing it through ClipCap.

answer_2.quote: Retrieval is successful if the dot product between the resulting caption and target image representations is larger than that of the embedded caption with any distractor representation.

answer_4.quote: we organized a crowd-sourcing experiment in which human subjects had to perform the same 10-image-set target discrimination task we submitted to the neural image retriever.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to click on the image that matched the caption best.
